mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Verona City Hall with a comfortable temperature of 61 degrees.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician until September 20, and residents can also look into the rain barrel rebate program which offers a 30 dollar credit for eligible properties.

Today you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at local venues like Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow features a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
On Friday, August 15, officers responded to a call regarding a 44-year-old woman who was found passed out in her vehicle, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.
Today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM, so stop by later today for a scoop.
